messages:
Ben: Hi - noticed p99 on our hosted endpoint jumped from ~1.2s to ~3.8s after enabling a new int8 quant profile yesterday. Model: redwood-4b-chat-int8. Mostly short prompts (<150 tokens).
Jen (support): sorry to hear that, can you share a slow request_id and when you flipped the profile? Was the change via Console or API?
Ben: request_id=req_20260315_1143, slow at 2026-03-15T11:43:22Z. I changed the profile with PATCH /v1/models/{id}/profile to int8-calib-v2 around 2026-03-15 20:00 UTC.
Raj (oncall): grabbing infra metrics now. I see a background calibration job kicked off for int8-calib-v2 at ~2026-03-15T20:01Z. Can you hold while I pull kernel traces?
Jen: pulling runtime logs for that window. snapshot: 
```
2026-03-15T20:01:03Z calibration: start profile=int8-calib-v2 model=redwood-4b-chat
2026-03-15T20:10:45Z batch_exec: kernel=attn_conv fallback=true seq_len=128 latency=3100ms
2026-03-15T20:12:10Z request=req_20260315_1143 p99=3750ms
```
Alex (runtime): that log shows kernel falling back to a non-optimized path during/after calibration. Likely per-layer scales from calibration caused kernel selection to prefer a slower kernel at seq_len=128.
Maya (ml-eng): int8 calibration can alter activation histograms. If the calibration sample is too small or not diverse, it can produce scale/zero-point pairs that trigger slower code paths or extra ops. Any reports of generation quality issues?
Ben: quality mostly fine, maybe a handful of slightly different token choices but nothing catastrophic. The big issue is latency: p95 went from ~900ms to ~1.8s and p99 spiked to ~3.8s.
Jen: short mitigation: revert the model's active profile to fp16-stable and set auto_fallback=true in the profile so runtime auto-falls back when slow kernels are encountered.
Alex: exact rollback command for ops/customers: 
```
PATCH /v1/models/redwood-4b-chat/profile
{ "active_profile": "fp16-stable" }
```
Also recommend enabling runtime guard: fallback to fp16 if kernel latency > 200ms compared to baseline.
Ben: I rolled back at 2026-03-16T02:04Z. New test request: req_20260316_0206.
Jen: confirming: req_20260316_0206 p99=1.05s, p95=780ms — back to expected performance. :thumbsup:
Raj: root-cause hypothesis: int8-calib-v2's calibration produced quant params that caused suboptimal kernel selection for common seq lengths. The calibration job overlapped with production traffic and produced a transient latency regime.
Maya: plan for a robust fix: re-run calibration with a larger, stratified token sample and switch calibration_mode from "layerwise_minmax" to "ema_stats". Increase calibration tokens from 10k -> 100k for redwood-4b-chat. Output new profile int8-calib-v3.
Alex: runtime protections to implement: 1) mark profile state as "profiling" while calibration runs and keep routing traffic to fp16 by default; 2) implement a kernel-latency guard that triggers fallback to fp16 when unexplained degradation detected for 3 consecutive minutes.
Jen: ops runbook (short):
- rollback active_profile -> fp16-stable (done)
- set auto_fallback: true on the model profile
- schedule calibration: `calibrate --model redwood-4b-chat --tokens 100000 --mode ema_stats --out int8-calib-v3`
- staged rollout: 1% -> 10% -> 100% with p95/p99 and eval checks
Ben: can we auto-rollback if p99 > 2500ms for 5 minutes?
Raj: yes, adding a temporary routing rule prototype: 
```
rule {
  when: p99_latency > 2500ms for 5m
  action: set active_profile = "fp16-stable"
}
```
I'll file a ticket to add this to Console policies.
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T02:10:12 by jen: rolled back redwood-4b-chat profile -> fp16-stable (canary 100%).
Jen: follow-ups assigned:
- SRE: add auto-rollback policy to Console (Raj)
- ML: run extended calibration + evals (Maya)
- Runtime: add kernel latency guard and profiling state (Alex)
- Support: confirm customer perf baseline and monitor (Jen)
Maya: calibration validation note: we'll run a 200-prompt eval (mix of short and long) and abort if any prompt shows >2% quality regression or hallucination increase. We'll also capture per-token latency distributions.
Ben: thanks all — rollback fixed the immediate issue. Please keep me posted when v3 is safe to try.
Jen: closing this escalation as mitigated for now. We retained logs and linked ticket INC-2026-4521. If you see any new regressions, ping @oncall_raj.
Raj: saved logs and kernel traces to the incident ticket. Monitoring alerts configured for p95/p99 thresholds.
